reviews.text: Best place in Vancouver!
I have such a great experience with the groomer. Ivonne is so kind and gentle with my dog Jessa. Thank you Ivonne.
Awesome shop, first time taking our Luna in for a nail trim.  It's the first place Luna had stayed calm getting the trim anywhere.
Great service so kind and professional the best! Shotout to ivonne bombon 🙌 …
I wouldn’t go anywhere else! They take such good care of the dogs and communicate the whole process so there are no surprises at pick up. They are the best!
Amazing service and reasonable prices! Dog looks so good.
They always do such a great job on Simon! We love the team here ❤️
Best groomers in town loves the staff and professionalism

I can’t recommend this place more!! We got a new puppy, Maltese (so very soft, fine hair) and we were so nervous about getting him groomed for the first time. We wanted it to be a positive experience for him and finding somewhere to trust with your fur baby is hard! I spoke to the owner and the phone who was so friendly, informative and reassuring.

Our puppy went in for his puppy intro groom and had lots of mats… they were so careful and were able to slowly get the mats out almost completely without shaving him! They were so attentive to make it a positive experience for him!! He didn’t even seem scared or nervous 🐾🐶🥰 THANK YOU woof! The owner is amazing, lovely to speak to and they even helped educate us on how to brush him to prevent more mats. We will be back! Highly recommend!! 🩷
Such a lovely team and location ❤️
Yvonne is amazing! Such lovely staff and exceptional service! Would definitely recommend :)
My puppy’s first haircut looked great!
Everyone is amazing!

I always have a wonderful experience at Wood Dog Shoppe! They do an amazing job grooming my dog, and I couldn’t be happier with the results. From the moment we walked in, the staff was warm, welcoming, and clearly passionate about what they do.

They took the time to listen to exactly how I wanted my dog groomed, and the final result was even better than I expected. My pup came home looking absolutely adorable, smelling fresh, and clearly feeling great. I could tell they handled him with patience and care throughout the entire process.

It’s not always easy to find a groomer you completely trust, but Wood Dog Shoppe has definitely earned mine. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for professional, caring, and high-quality grooming services. We’ll definitely be back! 🐶✨
I called in for a drop in appointment for a nail trim and wow, what a lovely experience. Very friendly staff and very efficient. Thank you for taking care of Poochy Simone today 🐾 …
Big shout out to the girls at Woof! Thank you for taking the time with my little Jimmy who is the squirmiest little Yorkie , much appreciated! he looks so cute!
They did a great job! Made my dog feel safe and well cared for as he was groomed. Thank you!

My dog is a sensitive little guy and he absolutely loves coming to get groomed here. All of the groomers are fantastic and treat him so gently and thoughtfully while also doing a great job. Thank you so much!
Great service and our dog loves going to get groomed and is so happy after!

We love Woof! So thankful for the drop in services, especially to trim up our English cockers feet and nails. The staff are all amazing, and I know our girl is in great hands. Thank you for keeping her comfy and beautiful!

My dog always gets a good groom here. He doesn't love getting groomed but he endures it happily and likes all the humans who work here too, which is about as much as I could ask for. Best groomer we've been to.
I have had nothing but AMAZING experiences at Woof! Dog Shoppe. I've been going since 2020, and for 5 years they've done an expert job at grooming my doodle. I love them!

Woof Dog Shoppe was the third place we took our standard poodle to when she was just a few years old, and we are so happy with them! Our girl is always welcomed with kind, enthusiastic words, and a steady hand on the clippers. She always looks so great afterwards, the groomers are competent and efficient. So glad we tried them, and you will be too!

I have been bringing my dog to Woof Dog Shoppe for almost 4 years. I wouldn't think to take him anywhere else. Woof is without a doubt, consistently the BEST dog grooming shop. My dog is so well taken care of and he looks amazing every single time. The owner is professional, friendly and just loves all the dogs :) Her staff is first class. Thank you! - Katie and pup, Joey
The Staff and facilities at WOOF Dog Shop on 1st at Cypress Street in Kitsilano are terrific.  You wouldn’t find my Standard Poodle at any other groomers —- it’s the best in town.   Liz and Winnie
Love Woof! Been going for 8 years plus.
I am always happy with the grooming that my dog receives. She is a nervous dog, but is fine at Woof Dog Shoppe. I find all the staff to be very friendly and attentive. They love dogs!
Staff were so friendly and took such great care of my dog here for her nail trimming. My dog and I had a great all around experience; professional, pleasant and great value.
Cooper Blue is such a happy boy and always welcome !

My standard poodle Aidan is incredibly well looked after by the team at Woof.  Yuki, the owner, is omnipresent - and runs an efficient, clean and friendly operation.  The booking and reminder system is excellent - also easy to make changes.  They have two poodle specialists, who know all the right things to do, to ensure that my boy is content, patient and happy to go there.  They also have a great selection of treats and accessories.  I would not hesitate to recommend Woof:  BUT, book well in advance, they are incredibly busy

Emma is absolutely amazing with my Pomeranian! She grooms her with such care and attention to detail, and always leaves her looking and feeling great. The 'bubble butt' is always on point! Highly recommend Emma for her expertise and gentle touch.

Love Woof! Best dog grooming my dogs, Snoopy & Ziggy (and I) have ever experienced. The owner Yuki and all the staff are wonderful. They groom both of my doggos (at the same time), which is only possible because all the groomers are so excellent, that I know that any 2 groomers scheduled will do great cuts for both my Furbabies.  Even if the doggos and I are just passing by, they will pull towards Woof to say hello - never happened with any other groomers in my experience (and I have been to a few). lol. Seamless service - from booking, to appointment reminders, to check-in to letting you know when to come pick-up. Bonus - if you go regularly, Woof will do complimentary nail and face trim in between keeping your furbabies neat and tidy.  Highly recommend. Thank you Woof!

My dog’s fur was badly matted. Sammy did an amazing job of getting her all tidied up and despite the disaster I presented her with, even managed to get her ears and muzzle shaped the way I like. Sammy greets my girl with warmth and has a lovely, calm demeanour. I love the convenience of being able to pop in for a quick nail trim or to tidy up her face, en route to the dog beach that is minutes away. We tried 2 other places before we found WOOF, at the recommendation of a fellow dog owner and WOOF is where we’ll stay.

We have been taking our male purebred Australian shepherd here for years. They do a phenomenal job every time. If we have any special requests they accommodate them with ease. We always get so many compliments on our dog after his grooming apts. Highly recommended them for dog grooming!
Our go-to establishment for our dog’s grooming needs. Staff is always nice and attentive. Highly recommend!

I’ve been a customer at Woof for ~8 years now. First, I brought my standard poodle, Bob, and now I have my new furry friend (also poodle), Beau. They’ve always been accommodating, professional, caring, and incredibly skilled. Bob had some serious separation anxiety, and they were always so patient with his singing and impatience. My dogs always look and feel amazing after every visit - I highly recommend them!
Good service  i wud recommend!!
We had an excellent experience at Woof. They took great care of our pup and gave her a great haircut. Thanks so much from Keeley and her humans

We love this place! After trying several groomers in our pup’s 12 years, this one is the one that has been the best fit. They prioritize his comfort over anything else and as he’s aged that has been so appreciated. Some days his bones hurt and he has a hard time with a full groom. They do their best in terms of aesthetic but prioritize his hygiene and comfort, never pushing him beyond his limits. I’m so grateful for the folks who work here and how much they care about their clients.  Woof is the only place we’ll take our little old man!
They were really friendly, gentle, and kind with our new little puppy. His grooming looked great after too.
Emma literally got on the floor to help my puppy feel comfortable during his first nail and face trim. Thank you so much! We’ll be back :)
Alison and Sammy are so great with my very anxious/naughty dog Red! The whole Woof team is very patient with him, despite being very tough to groom!

Walking by and stopped in to look at some treats,  and had some questions about their services. The employee at the front desk (I think her name was Emma?)  was super helpful and friendly, and did a great job answering my questions!! Really good environment and I’ll definitely be returning!
